basic_profile.bio: I'm a high school student living in Boston, with a keen interest in gaming, especially World of Warcraft. When I'm not online, you can find me exploring the latest tech gadgets or sampling the local food scene. I'm usually active on Reddit in the evenings after school and during weekends. Currently single, I'm focused on my studies and part-time job at a local restaurant. I enjoy a good laugh and am often found in subreddits that provide humor and entertainment.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Most of my knowledge comes from self-teaching through online forums and YouTube tutorials, particularly in gaming and tech. I've also picked up a lot from discussions in the subreddits I frequent.
